description: The server and the whole library as JSON: this server's package name and version (which build is loaded), its log file; evidence directory (evidence_dir) and host; entry count and size on disk; per type (pmid, doi, dailymed, nct) the entries by level (full_text, abstract, title) and retractions; counts of retracted and not-citable entries and of errata, expressions of concern and updates; the retrieval sources in run order and which are off (tiers); the multi-stage download (download): the Playwright servers with the version they must run, the Chrome stages, whether an unlocker is configured; the configuration and where each value came from — environment, .env or default, never the value (config); the decision model behind fh_verify_claim and whether it answers right now (verify); the unlockers and whether each answers right now (unlockers); our own stage hosts — fetch proxy, Playwright servers, Chrome — and whether each is reachable right now (stages); this server's cache hits and misses for fh_verify_claim and fh_fetch_url since it started (cache).
name: fh_info
